Algorithm: stable first-fit decreasing. Sort streams and palettes largest-to-smallest, retain manifest order as the tie-breaker, and place each item in the first 32 KiB bank where it fits. This determines bank membership, not order inside a bank. The bars and address-prefixed listings show the linker's actual intra-bank order from the final map.
